request.description:
### Register User

This endpoint is used to register a new user.

#### Request Body

- email (string, required): The email address of the user.
    
- password (string, required): The password for the user account.
    
- firstName (string, required): The first name of the user.
    
- lastName (string, required): The last name of the user.
    

Example:

``` json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "yourPassword123",
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe"
}

 ```

#### Response

- Status: 201 Created
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    

Example:

``` json
{
  "message": ""
}

 ```

request.description:
### Register Speaker

This endpoint allows users to register as a speaker.

#### Request Body

- email (string, required): The email of the speaker.
    
- password (string, required): The password for the speaker's account.
    
- firstName (string, required): The first name of the speaker.
    
- lastName (string, required): The last name of the speaker.
    
- expertise (array of strings, required): The expertise areas of the speaker.
    
- pricePerSession (number, required): The price per session for the speaker's services.
    

#### Response

The response for this request is a JSON object with the following properties:

- message (string): A message related to the registration process.
    
- tempCode (string): A temporary code, if applicable.
    

#### Example

Request:

``` json
{
  "email": "ashutoshgaharwar05@gmail.com",
  "password": "password123",
  "firstName": "Ashutosh",
  "lastName": "Gaharwar",
  "expertise": ["JavaScript"],
  "pricePerSession": 50
}

 ```

Response:

``` json
{
  "message": "",
  "tempCode": ""
}

 ```

response.name: Register Speaker

request.description:
### Login API

This API endpoint is used to authenticate and login a user.

#### Request Body

- `email` (string): The email address of the user.
    
- `password` (string): The password of the user.
    
- `userType` (string): The type of user, e.g., "SPEAKER".
    

#### Response

Upon successful authentication, the API returns a status code of 200 and a JSON object with a `token` field.

Example Response:

``` json
{
    "token": ""
}

 ```

### GET /api/speakers

This endpoint retrieves a list of speakers.

#### Request

No request body is required for this endpoint.

#### Response

The response will be a JSON array containing speaker objects with the following properties:

- `id` (string): The unique identifier of the speaker.
    
- `firstName` (string): The first name of the speaker.
    
- `lastName` (string): The last name of the speaker.
    
- `expertise` (array of strings): An array of expertise areas of the speaker.
    
- `pricePerSession` (number): The price per session for the speaker.
    
- `timeSlots` (array): An array of time slots available for the speaker.
    

Example response:

``` json
[
  {
    "id": "",
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "",
    "expertise": [""],
    "pricePerSession": 0,
    "timeSlots": []
  }
]

 ```

### Update Speaker Profile

This endpoint allows the client to update the profile of a speaker.

#### Request Body

- `expertise` (array of strings, required): An array of expertise areas for the speaker.
    
- `pricePerSession` (number, required): The price per session for the speaker.
    

#### Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string" },
    "email": { "type": "string" },
    "password": { "type": "string" },
    "firstName": { "type": "string" },
    "lastName": { "type": "string" },
    "expertise": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "pricePerSession": { "type": "number" },
    "isVerified": { "type": "boolean" },
    "otpCode": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "otpExpires": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "createdAt": { "type": "string" },
    "updatedAt": { "type": "string" }
  }
}

 ```

### Add Speaker Time Slots

This endpoint allows you to add time slots for speakers on a specific date.

#### Request Body

- `date` (string): The date for which the time slots are being added.
    
- `slots` (array): An array of objects containing the start and end time for each slot.
    

Example:

``` json
{
  "date": "2025-05-04",
  "slots": [
    {
      "startTime": "2025-05-04T04:30:00.000Z",
      "endTime": "2025-05-04T05:30:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

#### Response

- `id` (string): The unique identifier for the time slot.
    
- `speakerId` (string): The ID of the speaker associated with the time slot.
    
- `date` (string): The date for which the time slot is added.
    
- `startTime` (string): The start time of the time slot.
    
- `endTime` (string): The end time of the time slot.
    
- `isBooked` (boolean): Indicates if the time slot is booked or not.
    
- `createdAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was created.
    
- `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was last updated.
    

Example Response:

``` json
[
  {
    "id": "",
    "speakerId": "",
    "date": "",
    "startTime": "",
    "endTime": "",
    "isBooked": true,
    "createdAt": "",
    "updatedAt": ""
  }
]

 ```

The endpoint retrieves a list of time slots for speakers via an HTTP GET request to {{baseUrl}}/api/speakers/time-slots.

### Response

The response will be a JSON array containing objects with the following properties:

- `id` (string): The unique identifier for the time slot.
    
- `speakerId` (string): The identifier of the speaker associated with the time slot.
    
- `date` (string): The date of the time slot.
    
- `startTime` (string): The start time of the time slot.
    
- `endTime` (string): The end time of the time slot.
    
- `isBooked` (boolean): Indicates whether the time slot is booked or not.
    
- `createdAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was created.
    
- `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was last updated.
    
- `session` (object or null): Details of the session associated with the time slot, or null if not applicable.
    

#### Example

``` json
[
  {
    "id": "",
    "speakerId": "",
    "date": "",
    "startTime": "",
    "endTime": "",
    "isBooked": true,
    "createdAt": "",
    "updatedAt": "",
    "session": null
  }
]

 ```

### Create a New Session Booking

This endpoint allows the user to book a new session by sending a POST request to the specified URL.

#### Request Body

- timeSlotId (string): The ID of the time slot for the session booking.
    

#### Response

Upon successful execution, the server returns a status code of 201 and a JSON object with the following properties:

- id (string): The ID of the session booking.
    
- userId (string): The ID of the user who booked the session.
    
- speakerId (string): The ID of the speaker for the session.
    
- timeSlotId (string): The ID of the time slot for the session.
    
- status (string): The status of the booking.
    
- createdAt (string): The timestamp of creation.
    
- updatedAt (string): The timestamp of the last update.
    
- user (object): Details of the user who booked the session.
    
    - id (string): The ID of the user.
        
    - email (string): The email of the user.
        
    - firstName (string): The first name of the user.
        
    - lastName (string): The last name of the user.
        
    - isVerified (boolean): Indicates if the user is verified.
        
    - userType (string): The type of user.
        
    - createdAt (string): The timestamp of user creation.
        
    - updatedAt (string): The timestamp of the last user update.
        
- speaker (object): Details of the speaker for the session.
    
    - id (string): The ID of the speaker.
        
    - email (string): The email of the speaker.
        
    - firstName (string): The first name of the speaker.
        
    - lastName (string): The last name of the speaker.
        
    - expertise (array): The expertise of the speaker.
        
    - pricePerSession (number): The price per session charged by the speaker.
        
    - isVerified (boolean): Indicates if the speaker is verified.
        
    - createdAt (string): The timestamp of speaker creation.
        
    - updatedAt (string): The timestamp of the last speaker update.
        
- timeSlot (object): Details of the time slot for the session.
    
    - id (string): The ID of the time slot.
        
    - speakerId (string): The ID of the speaker for the time slot.
        
    - date (string): The date of the time slot.
        
    - startTime (string): The start time of the time slot.
        
    - endTime (string): The end time of the time slot.
        
    - isBooked (boolean): Indicates if the time slot is booked.
        
    - createdAt (string): The timestamp of time slot creation.
        
    - updatedAt (string): The timestamp of the last time slot update.
        
- calendar (object): Details of the calendar event.
    
    - eventUrl (string): The URL of the calendar event.
        

#### Example Response

``` json
{
  "id": "",
  "userId": "",
  "speakerId": "",
  "timeSlotId": "",
  "status": "",
  "createdAt": "",
  "updatedAt": "",
  "user": {
    "id": "",
    "email": "",
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "",
    "isVerified": true,
    "userType": "",
    "createdAt": "",
    "updatedAt": ""
  },
  "speaker": {
    "id": "",
    "email": "",
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "",
    "expertise": [""],
    "pricePerSession": 0,
    "isVerified": true,
    "createdAt": "",
    "updatedAt": ""
  },
  "timeSlot": {
    "id": "",
    "speakerId": "",
    "date": "",
    "startTime": "",
    "endTime": "",
    "isBooked": true,
    "createdAt": "",
    "updatedAt": ""
  },
  "calendar": {
    "eventUrl": ""
  }
}

 ```

request.description:
The endpoint retrieves sessions associated with the current user.

### Request

No request body is required for this request.

### Response

The response is a JSON array containing session objects with the following properties:

- `id` (string): The ID of the session.
    
- `userId` (string): The ID of the user associated with the session.
    
- `speakerId` (string): The ID of the speaker associated with the session.
    
- `timeSlotId` (string): The ID of the time slot for the session.
    
- `status` (string): The status of the session.
    
- `createdAt` (string): The timestamp when the session was created.
    
- `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp when the session was last updated.
    
- `speaker` (object): An object containing details of the speaker, including:
    
    - `firstName` (string): The first name of the speaker.
        
    - `lastName` (string): The last name of the speaker.
        
    - `email` (string): The email address of the speaker.
        
    - `expertise` (array of strings): An array of expertise areas of the speaker.
        
- `timeSlot` (object): An object containing details of the time slot, including:
    
    - `id` (string): The ID of the time slot.
        
    - `speakerId` (string): The ID of the speaker associated with the time slot.
        
    - `date` (string): The date of the time slot.
        
    - `startTime` (string): The start time of the time slot.
        
    - `endTime` (string): The end time of the time slot.
        
    - `isBooked` (boolean): Indicates if the time slot is booked.
        
    - `createdAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was created.
        
    - `updatedAt` (string): The timestamp when the time slot was last updated.
        

The response status for this request is 200 (OK).

#### JSON Schema

``` json
{
  "type": "array",
  "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "id": {"type": "string"},
      "userId": {"type": "string"},
      "speakerId": {"type": "string"},
      "timeSlotId": {"type": "string"},
      "status": {"type": "string"},
      "createdAt": {"type": "string"},
      "updatedAt": {"type": "string"},
      "speaker": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "firstName": {"type": "string"},
          "lastName": {"type": "string"},
          "email": {"type": "string"},
          "expertise": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {"type": "string"}
          }
        }
      },
      "timeSlot": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {"type": "string"},
          "speakerId": {"type": "string"},
          "date": {"type": "string"},
          "startTime": {"type": "string"},
          "endTime": {"type": "string"},
          "isBooked": {"type": "boolean"},
          "createdAt": {"type": "string"},
          "updatedAt": {"type": "string"}
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

 ```
